reason_specialist_rationale: Calls it disorganized poorly differentiated colorectal adenocarcinoma; elongated bland spindle nuclei in bundles are muscle, not tumour.
Disorganized, no glands is accurate, but the poorly differentiated colorectal adenocarcinoma call is unsupported.
Form template with invented lesion type, site, size and 'growing'; no image description.
Describes dark brown/black pigment, spiculation and regression dots in a pale pink lesion with no black pigment; near-100% malignancy claim is unjustified.
Calls papilledema from disc oedema and blurred margins; the disc is a well-defined round disc, and the urgent intracranial work-up is misleading.
Spindle cells right but pleomorphism, hyperchromasia and sarcoma not seen; high confidence unjustified.
Diffuse pattern with lymphoid-type cells is closest to reality, but strongly implies neoplasm when inflammatory/necrotic debris is more likely.
Describes a 1.5 cm lung nodule and pneumothorax in metastatic breast cancer; nothing relates to this dermoscopy image and it loops.
Asserts clear glaucomatous damage with no description on a black image.
Describes a well-defined disc and normal retina in a black image; false reassurance.
Looped yes-tumour at 100% with no description; false positive.
Diagnoses macular hole at 95% on a completely black image; nothing is visible.
CRVO with swollen disc and haemorrhages and urgent anti-VEGF; none of those is visible.
